prose: The Wall Street Journal traces how effective altruism shaped AI safety thinking and Anthropic itself - including the detail that some early Anthropic employees are considering buying remote US land as a relocation option if AI goes awry. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
